title: Megurine Luka — Here Comes The Free Spirit!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Campground

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Whoa! Check out all the stars!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Look, it's great that you're all excited about this, but you guys need to make sure no one else sees you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<We know! We'll be fine!
Oh, Toya, what's that star called? The one way over there.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's Canis Major, better known as Sirius. The star you're seeing is actually the second brightest in the sky next to the sun. It's even a part of the Winter Triangle.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That's so cool! Oh, what about those three over there?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, those are...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, didn't I just tell you to keep it down...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. They're having the time of their lives.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I don't blame them. Who wouldn't be excited about seeing a star-studded sky like this?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, it's very romantic.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Between the campground, this campfire and all these stars... I'm not sure what to do with myself♪>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you guys could join us! It's made our campfire just that much better!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, An, that's so sweet of you!
It's like this campfire's making us better friends already♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Which means we have no other choice but to do this...!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do what?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Sing camp songs together!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <There she goes again...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Camp songs...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, that sounds fun!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Camp songs...?
I'm not really sure if I know any.
Can you give us an example?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<You know!
Those songs that you sing when you're all around a campfire!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <There are lots of them too, and they all sound really fun and have a great rhythm to them...♪>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know what you mean!
My dad and I used to sing them all the time whenever we went camping...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There are some fun folk songs that we can try where you clap along as you sing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<That'd be great!
Oh, the one about rowing a boat could be fun too.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know that one at least.
I remember my mom teaching us that during one camping trip when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
I don't seem to recognize any of those songs.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I see...
That just means we'll have to sing some for you, Toya!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You say that, but I have a feeling you were gonna make us sing them anyway. Am I wrong?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Haha. Too easy?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Anyway, let's sing some!
Also, don't forget to clap during the quiet parts too. I'm sure it'll be more fun that way!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, I wanna try that!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Me too!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And I'll play whatever music you need. Oh, but I'm gonna need to carry some speakers over to do that. Mind giving me a hand, MEIKO...?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. Do I really have a choice? Be right there.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, Aoyagi, do you know the lyrics? I don't really remember all of them, so why don't we look at them together while we sing?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If that's the case, let's just check out a video online first! That should make it easier for you to learn the lyrics, right, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that would help quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't remember all of it either, so I'll take a look too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. There we go! That's the spirit♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Alright, everyone, are you ready?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: <Yeah♪>
